title: SKM500MB120SC SiC MOSFET Module (SEMITRANS 3, full SiC half-bridge) datasheet, Rev. 1.0, 14.08.2020
method: Table values copied from the datasheet text with a fetch tool (no curve digitized). R_DS(on) and V_SD are chip-level values at I_D 264 A, V_GS 18 V (not at rated current). Switching energies are given ONLY at Tj 150 C and I_D 150 A (no 25 C values, no stray inductance stated) and are not comparable 1:1 with the other parts' rated-current values. I_DM is printed as 'IDM 1920 A' with no t_p condition; 'IDRM 1356 A' also printed without condition. R_thJH not stated (R_thJC 0.08 + R_thCH 0.025 per MOSFET would give 0.105 K/W, derived only). Z_th given only as a graph (Fig. 14); no Foster r_i/tau_i in the text. Tj range -40...175 C (abs. max); recommended Tjop -40...+150 C.

mosfet.I_D_note: Tj = 175 C, T_c 80 C; 485 A at T_c 25 C
mosfet.R_DSon_cond: V_GS 18 V, I_D 264 A, chip level
mosfet.E_cond: V_DD 600 V, I_D 150 A, V_GS -5...20 V, R_Gon 0.7 ohm, R_Goff 0.7 ohm, di/dt_on 9.8 kA/us, di/dt_off 2.7 kA/us, dv/dt_off 19.4 kV/us, Tj 150 C (inductive not stated explicitly)
mosfet.E_rr_cond: V_DD 600 V, -I_D 150 A, di/dt_off 8.4 kA/us, V_GS -5 V, R_Gon 0.7 ohm
mosfet.V_SD_cond: inverse diode V_F = V_SD, -I_D 264 A, V_GS 0 V, chip level
mosfet.R_thCH_note: per MOSFET, lambda_grease 0.81 W/(m*K); per module 0.013 (no coupling) / 0.014 (with coupling) K/W
